description: Fire/Rescue Responses is published by Gainesville Fire Rescue (GFR). The fire-rescue table reports incident dates, call categories and responding units. Its stated coverage is Gainesville, United States; fiscal 2012 onward. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. Records describe responses, not independent measures of service outcomes. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
